title: CarrierDocumentReviewed
description: An operator approved or rejected a carrier's document. A person paper names `subject_user_id`, a vehicle paper `vehicle_id`; an organization's own names neither.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

note.description: What the operator wrote; a rejection always has one.

subject_user_id.description: The person a person paper (passport, driving licence) is about.

vehicle_id.description: The truck a vehicle paper (registration, power of attorney) is about.
